implementation_expectation: Define asset inventory and role boundaries; enforce secure authentication and MFA at remote and privileged entry points; restrict management paths.
evidence_required: IAM policies; AD group and GPO exports; authentication settings; asset-to-role inventory
testing_procedure: Inspect all privileged entry points in the scoped inventory; in an authorized lab verify an unassigned account cannot access an administrative resource.
identified_gap: Native AD DS alone does not supply MFA for every protocol; identify VPN or identity-provider enforcement and legacy exceptions.
remediation_action: Add MFA integration or isolate legacy paths with an approved compensating control.

implementation_expectation: Require manager and system-owner authorization before provisioning; disable leaver access at effective termination and reconcile downstream identities.
evidence_required: HR lifecycle population; approved requests; creation and disable timestamps; downstream revocation receipts
testing_procedure: Reconcile complete period HR joiner and leaver list to all scoped identity stores; compare approvals to grant times and termination to disable times.
identified_gap: Disabling AD does not revoke unrelated cloud accounts or existing sessions.
remediation_action: Track separate AWS revocations and session invalidation; investigate every unmatched lifecycle event.

implementation_expectation: Review all human and service identities quarterly; review privileged roles monthly; remove incompatible and unjustified rights.
evidence_required: Complete account and group export; signed access review; remediation tickets; removal verification
testing_procedure: Reconcile review rows to full identity population; inspect decisions and independently verify each removal ticket against current effective access.
identified_gap: A reviewer decision alone is not evidence that access was removed; nested groups and service identities can be missed.
remediation_action: Close SYN-AR-002 with removal evidence; add nested and non-human identities to population reconciliation.

technology: Facilities badge system; AWS supplier assurance
implementation_expectation: Approve badge access to office and server areas; escort visitors; obtain scoped supplier assurance for provider-operated facilities.
evidence_required: Badge inventory; visitor and entry logs; access approvals; AWS assurance scope and customer responsibility review
testing_procedure: Compare all active badges to approved roster; inspect sampled visitor escort records; verify supplier report scope and bridge-period coverage.
identified_gap: AD, Wazuh and endpoint tooling cannot establish data-center physical access compliance; no supplier report is included.
remediation_action: Obtain authorized supplier assurance and review coverage; implement office badge evidence collection.

technology: Asset inventory; Active Directory; AWS storage
implementation_expectation: Reconcile retired assets to sanitization records and authorized release; handle cloud versions, snapshots and keys under service-specific procedures.
evidence_required: Retirement population; sanitization verification; disposal authorization; cloud deletion and snapshot review records
testing_procedure: For every release in a small period population verify successful sanitization preceded release and asset identifiers match; inspect cloud retention exceptions separately.
identified_gap: An AD computer deletion or EC2 termination does not prove disk sanitization or deletion of all retained copies.
remediation_action: Require verified sanitization before release and documented treatment of backups and cloud retained copies.

technology: AWS security groups; Active Directory remote access
implementation_expectation: Restrict administrative ingress to approved management networks; separate management and application paths; review external exposure.
evidence_required: Security-group and route exports; approved network diagram; exposure findings; exception approvals
testing_procedure: Enumerate scoped public routes and security-group rules; check administrative ports for unrestricted IPv4 and IPv6 sources; reconcile exceptions.
identified_gap: Security groups alone do not establish the entire perimeter; routes, NACLs, load balancers and IPv6 also matter.
remediation_action: Remove SYN-CF-001 public SSH ingress using an approved change and verify both IP families.

implementation_expectation: Approve destinations and recipients; restrict exports and removable media; protect transfer channels; record exceptions and monitor failed controls.
evidence_required: Transfer authorization; destination policy; TLS enforcement; endpoint export restriction; transfer monitoring records
testing_procedure: Inspect sampled approvals and recipients; in an approved lab attempt an unauthorized destination and insecure transport; confirm denial and telemetry.
identified_gap: Encryption does not authorize a transfer; endpoint DLP depends on purchased features and cannot cover all channels.
remediation_action: Validate approved destinations and all scoped channels; document unmonitored channels and feature limits.

implementation_expectation: Assign threat-protection policies to every managed endpoint; protect settings; detect stale or missing agents and verify controlled software installation.
evidence_required: Endpoint inventory; Sophos policy and health export; detection and response record; software approval evidence
testing_procedure: Reconcile all scoped endpoints to active protection; use an approved harmless test in a disposable lab and inspect detection and response timing.
identified_gap: An installed agent is not proof of coverage or prevention; Sophos exports require a configured connector for Wazuh correlation.
remediation_action: Reconcile missing endpoints and stale policies; validate alert ingestion without introducing live malware.

implementation_expectation: Maintain scan and inventory coverage; detect vulnerable packages and baseline drift; prioritize findings and verify remediation.
evidence_required: Scan coverage; baseline version; drift findings; remediation and retest records
testing_procedure: Reconcile inventory to recent scan and recorder coverage; introduce only a harmless lab baseline deviation; verify finding and remediation tracking.
identified_gap: A vulnerability list without asset coverage and baseline context cannot show complete detection; Config requires supported resource recording.
remediation_action: Define assessment freshness and onboard omitted assets; track each finding to verified retest.

technology: Wazuh; Active Directory; Sophos; AWS CloudTrail
implementation_expectation: Enable scoped audit sources; ingest approved events; monitor feed health; correlate anomalies; preserve event and ingestion times in UTC.
evidence_required: Source inventory; ingestion health; detection rule version; alert-to-ticket trace; clock checks
testing_procedure: Generate an authorized benign event per source; reconcile source timestamps and arrival; verify anomaly alert and feed-outage detection.
identified_gap: A missing event can look like inactivity; CloudTrail management events do not imply selected data events are enabled.
remediation_action: Document event selectors, all accounts and Regions, feed freshness and independent heartbeat checks.

implementation_expectation: Assess alerts against severity, affected assets and service commitments; record incident or non-incident decision with rationale and accountable reviewer.
evidence_required: Alert context; triage record; declaration decision; severity and impact rationale
testing_procedure: Select high-severity alerts and a benign event; verify timely recorded evaluation, business impact rationale and incident/non-incident decision.
identified_gap: Vendor alert severity is not business incident severity; false-positive closure needs documented rationale.
remediation_action: Record business impact and independent triage quality review; tune repeatedly noisy rules.

implementation_expectation: Execute approved containment and eradication; preserve evidence; record decisions, authority, communications and action verification.
evidence_required: Incident timeline; containment approval; action receipts; custody ledger; communication decisions
testing_procedure: Trace incident from declaration to approved containment and eradication; inspect action confirmation, custody and communication decisions.
identified_gap: Wazuh alerts do not prove Sophos isolation or AD session revocation; authority and tool receipts are required.
remediation_action: Record product action receipts and separate identity and cloud session handling; exercise communications.

technology: AWS backup services; Active Directory; Sophos; Wazuh
implementation_expectation: Restore from trusted state; validate integrity, security and service health; obtain business acceptance; monitor recurrence and close lessons-learned actions.
evidence_required: Restore test; integrity and service checks; recovery approval; post-incident review; improvement tickets
testing_procedure: Observe lab restore and clean-state checks; compare recovery times to approved objectives; verify lessons learned and corrective action closure.
identified_gap: A successful backup job does not prove restoration; objectives depend on service commitments and risk.
remediation_action: Define RTO and RPO with business owners; test restoration and track recurring incident causes.

technology: AWS CloudTrail and Config; Active Directory GPO; Sophos policies; Wazuh rules
implementation_expectation: Assess impact; obtain independent approval; test and plan rollback; record deployment and verification; retrospectively review emergency changes.
evidence_required: Full change population; tickets; approvals; test and rollback records; deployment receipts; drift reconciliation
testing_procedure: Reconcile detected production changes to complete ticket population; inspect standard and emergency samples for approval, tests, rollback and verification.
identified_gap: CloudTrail records activity rather than approval or business intent; non-AWS changes require separate source records.
remediation_action: Reconcile independent change telemetry to tickets; investigate unmatched deployments and maintain segregation of duties.
